cases.sentence: Я заходил по тамбуру в ___ и все курил, курил…
cases.explain: «страшном волнении» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: I pace around in the vestibule, smoking the whole time.

cases.sentence: И принесли мне – что принесли? – две бутылки столичной и две банки ___.
cases.explain: «фаршированных томатов» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: "And when I turned thirty last fall? The day was dismal, like the day when I turned twenty. Borya came with some half-intelligent poetess, Vadya and Lida came, Ledik and Volodya. And they brought me? What? Two bottles of Stolichnaya and two cans of stuffed tomatoes. And such despair, such torment possessed me because of those tomatoes that I wanted to cry but now could not.

cases.sentence: Допустим, так: если ___ выпьет семьсот пятьдесят, он сделается буйным и радостным.
cases.explain: «тихий человек» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: ‘"Why? Very likely Ill be able to explain that to you, if 1 can find some kind of analogy for it from the world of the beautiful. Let’s say, for instance, a quiet person drinks 750 grams and becomes boisterous and full of joy. If he adds another 700, will he become even more boisterous and full of joy? No, he’ll quiet down again. It’lleven seem on the surface that he has sobered up. But does this mean that he has, in fact? Never happens. He’s just gotten piggishly drunk and is quiet for that reason."’

cases.sentence: Потому что человек этот стал жертвою своих шести или семи ___.
cases.explain: «служебных часов» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: I'll tell you why. Because you have fallen victim to your six or seven hours at work. You have to have the ability to choose your work; there aren’t any bad jobs or bad professions; one must respect every calling. It’s neces- sary, just after waking, to drink something right away, or, no, I’m lying, not "something" but precisely the same thing that you were drinking the day before—and drink it By) every forty or forty-five minutes so that toward evening you have drunk 250 grams more than the day before. Then there won’t be any queasiness or shyness and you will have such a white face it'll look as though it hasn’t been kicked around for six months.

cases.sentence: Надо уметь выбрать себе работу, ___ нет.
cases.explain: «плохих работ» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: I'll tell you why. Because you have fallen victim to your six or seven hours at work. You have to have the ability to choose your work; there aren’t any bad jobs or bad professions; one must respect every calling. It’s neces- sary, just after waking, to drink something right away, or, no, I’m lying, not "something" but precisely the same thing that you were drinking the day before—and drink it By) every forty or forty-five minutes so that toward evening you have drunk 250 grams more than the day before. Then there won’t be any queasiness or shyness and you will have such a white face it'll look as though it hasn’t been kicked around for six months.

cases.sentence: А сопоставив, начинал опять восстанавливать, напряжением памяти и со ___.
cases.explain: «всепроникающим анализом» — after the preposition «со», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: And, all the same, I wouldn’t wake up on Friday. I'd wake up on Saturday and not in Moscow either but under the railroad embankment in the Naro-Fominsk region. And later, I would, with effort, recollect and gather the facts. And having gathered them, I'd put them together. And having put them together, I would start again to recreate by straining my memory with the most penetrat- ing analysis. And, later, I'd go from observation to abstraction; in other words, thoughtfully I would have a morning-after drink and, finally, find out what had hap- pened to Friday.

cases.sentence: А потом переходил от созерцания к абстракции, ___, вдумчиво опохмелялся и, наконец, узнавал, куда же все-таки девалась пятница.
cases.explain: «другими словами» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: And, all the same, I wouldn’t wake up on Friday. I'd wake up on Saturday and not in Moscow either but under the railroad embankment in the Naro-Fominsk region. And later, I would, with effort, recollect and gather the facts. And having gathered them, I'd put them together. And having put them together, I would start again to recreate by straining my memory with the most penetrat- ing analysis. And, later, I'd go from observation to abstraction; in other words, thoughtfully I would have a morning-after drink and, finally, find out what had hap- pened to Friday.

cases.sentence: Сызмальства почти, от молодых ногтей, ___ моим было «дерзание».
cases.explain: «любимым словом» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: Ever since childhood, since thumb-sucking days, my favorite word has been "dare," and, as God is my witness, I took plenty of chances. If you took the chances I did, you'd either bust your gut or have a stroke. Or, actually, if at your age you took the chances I did, one fine morning you’d wake up dead. But I woke up every morning and started taking chances again.
